updates.activationPolicy: Confirm official completion of maintenance before activation. A date alone does not confirm deployment. Apply only to Champions and the default current reference, preserving historical games.
updates.evidence: Official Pokémon announcement supplied as three screenshots on 2026-11-20; cross-checked against published patch notes. No official maintenance completion yet.

abilities.stalwart: Retain redirection bypass; additionally ignore targets' substitutes when using moves.
